warmups.name: Stationary Bike
warmups.precautions: Sit/stand tall - no slouching or leaning on handles;Easy rhythm - you could hold a conversation;Smooth continuous movement - no coasting to a stop
warmups.cues: Easy pace - you can still talk;Move smoothly for the full time

warmups.name: Incline Walk
warmups.precautions: Sit/stand tall - no slouching or leaning on handles;Easy rhythm - you could hold a conversation;Smooth continuous movement - no coasting to a stop
warmups.cues: Easy pace - you can still talk;Move smoothly for the full time

warmups.name: Bodyweight Squat
warmups.precautions: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly turned out;Chest up, flat back - look straight ahead;Knees track over toes - never cave inward
warmups.cues: Feet shoulder-width apart;Chest up, sit back and down;Push through your heels to stand

warmups.name: Leg Swings
warmups.precautions: Feet hip-width, soft bend in knees that stays;Flat back the whole time - spine long, chest up;Push hips BACK - weight slides close to legs
warmups.cues: Hinge at hips, not a squat;Snap hips, let the bell float;Keep back flat and core tight

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.precautions: Whole foot flat on plate, heels never lift;Knees track exactly over toes - never cave inward;Lower back stays on pad - stop before it rounds;Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out
exercises.cues: Feet flat, shoulder-width on the plate;Knees track over your toes;Push through heels, don't lock knees

exercises.name: KB Goblet Squat
exercises.precautions: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly turned out;Chest up, flat back - look straight ahead;Knees track over toes - never cave inward;Weight in heels and mid-foot - heels stay down
exercises.cues: Feet shoulder-width apart;Chest up, sit back and down;Push through your heels to stand

exercises.name: DB Walking Lunge
exercises.precautions: Torso tall and upright - no leaning forward;Front knee tracks over toes - never caves inward;Whole front foot planted - push through heel;Back knee points down, hips square forward
exercises.cues: Long step, torso tall;Front knee tracks over toes;Push through front heel to stand

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.precautions: Knee joint lined up with machine pivot point;Back flat on pad, grip handles to stay still;No kicking - lift smoothly and pause at top;Lower slowly until weight nearly touches
exercises.cues: Knees lined up with the machine pivot;Lift with control, pause at top;Lower slowly, no swinging

exercises.name: KB Step-Up
exercises.precautions: Torso tall and upright - no leaning forward;Front knee tracks over toes - never caves inward;Whole front foot planted - push through heel;Back knee points down, hips square forward
exercises.cues: Whole foot on the step;Push through that heel to stand tall;Step down slowly and controlled

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.precautions: Entire back flat against wall, head touching;Feet shoulder-width, knees directly over ankles;Thighs parallel to floor if you can;Hands off thighs - arms across chest
exercises.cues: Back flat against the wall;Knees over ankles, thighs level if you can;Breathe steadily and hold

exercises.name: Hack Squat Machine
exercises.precautions: Shoulders and back flat against pads the whole time;Feet shoulder-width, whole foot on plate - heels down;Knees track exactly over toes - never cave in;Lower until thighs about parallel - stop if lower back lifts
exercises.cues: Feet shoulder-width on plate;Squat down with control;Push through heels to stand

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.precautions: Torso tall and upright - no leaning forward;Front foot flat - knee tracks over toes, never caves in;Back foot top rests on bench behind you;Hips square forward, both legs share the work
exercises.cues: One foot up on bench behind;Drop straight down;Push through front heel to rise

exercises.name: Stationary DB Lunge
exercises.precautions: Torso tall and upright - no leaning forward;Front knee tracks over front toes - never caves in;Whole front foot planted - push through heel;Step feet together between reps to reset
exercises.cues: Dumbbells at sides, feet together;Step forward and lower;Push back to standing

exercises.name: March in Place
exercises.precautions: Stand tall with a chair or wall within reach;Lift knees only as high as comfortable - thigh level is plenty;Land softly on the whole foot;Keep a steady, easy rhythm - you could hold a conversation
exercises.cues: Stand tall, swing arms gently;Lift one knee, then the other;Soft steps, steady rhythm

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stand
exercises.precautions: Use a sturdy chair or the couch edge - no wheels, no sinking seat;Feet flat, hip-width, slightly back under your knees;Lean your chest a little forward as you stand;Push with your hands on your thighs only if you need help
exercises.cues: Sit tall at the edge;Lean forward, push through heels;Stand tall, sit back down slowly

exercises.name: Step Jacks
exercises.precautions: Step wide, never jump - one foot always stays on the floor;Soft knees as each foot lands;Arms rise only as high as comfortable;Slow down any time - keep the rhythm easy
exercises.cues: Step out, arms rise;Step in, arms lower;Alternate sides smoothly

exercises.name: Step Touch
exercises.precautions: Stay tall - do not lean toward the stepping foot;Step wide enough to feel your hips work;Toes point forward on both feet;Hold a chair back if your balance feels unsure
exercises.cues: Step right, tap left foot in;Step left, tap right foot in;Easy side-to-side rhythm

exercises.name: Squat Jump (Step)
exercises.precautions: Use a low, stable step that cannot slide;Land softly with knees tracking over toes;Step down between reps if the jump feels uncontrolled;Stop if knees or ankles complain
exercises.cues: Squat, then jump up onto the step;Land soft and quiet;Stand tall on top before stepping down

exercises.name: Side Shuffles (Step)
exercises.precautions: Stay low in an athletic half-squat the whole time;One foot touches the step, other stays on the floor;Move light on your feet - no crossing feet over;Keep chest up, eyes forward
exercises.cues: Stay low;Shuffle side to side over the step;Quick, light feet

exercises.name: Squat to Step Jump
exercises.precautions: Squat to full depth first, then jump - two clear parts;Land on the step with both feet, soft knees;Step back down, never jump down;Use a low stable step
exercises.cues: Squat deep;Explode up onto the step;Step down, reset, repeat

exercises.name: Stepper Shuffles (Fast Feet)
exercises.precautions: Alternate feet tapping the step as fast as you can control;Stay on the balls of your feet;Keep hips low and core braced;If form breaks, slow the feet down
exercises.cues: Fast feet on and off the step;Stay light and low;Keep the rhythm steady

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.precautions: Land softly on the balls of your feet;Arms reach fully overhead each rep;Keep a steady rhythm you can breathe with;Use step jacks instead if joints prefer no jumping
exercises.cues: Jump feet wide, arms up;Jump back together;Soft, quiet landings

exercises.name: Malasana Walk
exercises.precautions: Stay in the deep squat and walk forward in small steps;Keep heels down as much as you can;Chest up, hands in prayer or on the floor for balance;Stand up and reset if form collapses
exercises.cues: Stay low in the squat;Small steps forward;Chest stays up

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.precautions: Squat down, then jump straight up;Land softly straight into the next squat;Knees track over toes, chest stays up;Swap to bodyweight squats if landings get noisy or sloppy
exercises.cues: Squat, jump, land soft;Flow straight into the next rep;Chest up

exercises.name: Squat to Calf Raise
exercises.precautions: Squat to comfortable depth;As you stand, rise straight onto your toes;Lower heels, flow into the next squat;Hold a wall for balance if needed
exercises.cues: Squat, stand, up on toes;Smooth rhythm;Heels lower softly

exercises.name: Squat to Floor Tap
exercises.precautions: Squat down and tap the floor with your fingertips;Keep heels down and chest as tall as you can;Stand fully between reps;Touch a raised surface instead if the floor is too far
exercises.cues: Squat, tap the floor;Stand tall;Repeat in rhythm

exercises.name: DB Clean to Front Squat
exercises.precautions: Hinge and clean the dumbbells up to shoulder height in one motion;Catch them softly at the shoulders, elbows up;Squat with chest tall, then stand and lower with control;Start light - the clean is a skill first
exercises.cues: Clean to shoulders;Elbows up, squat tall;Stand, lower, repeat

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.precautions: Hands down, jump or step feet back to plank;Chest to floor or plank hold - keep the back flat;Jump feet in, stand and finish with a small jump;Step back instead of jumping to scale it down
exercises.cues: Down to plank;Feet in, stand, jump;Keep a steady rhythm

exercises.name: Standing Leg Extension
exercises.precautions: Stand tall holding a counter or wall for balance;Straighten one knee fully without locking it hard;Keep the thigh still - only the lower leg moves;Lower slowly, no swinging
exercises.cues: Hold support, thigh still;Straighten the knee;Lower slowly

exercises.name: Running in Place
exercises.precautions: Jog lightly on the spot, landing on the balls of your feet;Keep the pace conversational for circuits;Pump the arms naturally;Slow to a march if your breathing spikes
exercises.cues: Light jog on the spot;Soft feet;Arms pumping gently

exercises.name: DB Front Squat
exercises.precautions: Rest the dumbbells on your shoulders, elbows up;Squat with your torso tall and heels down;Knees track over toes;Stand by driving the floor away, chest still tall
exercises.cues: Elbows up, chest tall;Squat deep;Drive up through heels

exercises.name: DB Cluster
exercises.precautions: A cluster is clean + front squat + press in one flowing rep;Catch the clean, squat immediately, and press as you stand;Keep the middle braced the whole rep;Use a weight you can press strictly when tired
exercises.cues: Clean, squat, press - one flow;Brace throughout;Smooth transitions

exercises.name: Lunge to Knee Drive
exercises.precautions: One dumbbell racked at the shoulder;Step back into a lunge, then drive the back knee up as you stand;Stay tall - the drive comes from the front leg;Complete all reps on one side before switching
exercises.cues: Lunge back;Drive the knee up tall;All reps one side, then switch

exercises.name: DB Front-Rack Lunge
exercises.precautions: Dumbbells racked at your shoulders the whole set;Step forward (or back) into the lunge, torso tall;Elbows stay up so the weights do not pull you forward;Push through the front heel to stand
exercises.cues: Racked tall, elbows up;Lunge with a tall torso;Drive through the front heel

exercises.name: Forward Lunge
exercises.precautions: Step forward into a long stride;Drop the back knee toward the floor, torso tall;Front knee tracks over its toes, never caves in;Push through the front heel to return
exercises.cues: Step long, drop tall;Front knee tracks straight;Push back through the heel

exercises.name: Burpee Box Jump Over
exercises.precautions: Advanced move - use a low, rock-solid box or step;Burpee beside the box, then jump laterally onto and over it;Land soft with both feet, knees tracking straight;Step over instead of jumping if there is any doubt
exercises.cues: Burpee, then jump over;Land soft, both feet;Reset each rep

exercises.name: Teep (Front Push Kick)
exercises.precautions: From a fighting stance, lift the knee then extend the leg in a forward push;Push through the ball of the foot, like pushing a door;Keep hands up and standing leg soft;Retract the leg before setting it down
exercises.cues: Knee up, push forward;Through the ball of the foot;Retract, reset stance

exercises.name: Step-Up Knee to Back Lunge
exercises.precautions: Step onto a chair-height platform and drive the free knee up;Step back down into a reverse lunge;Keep the torso tall through both parts;Use a low step until the combo is smooth
exercises.cues: Step up, knee drives;Down into a back lunge;Tall torso throughout

exercises.name: Sumo Squat to High Pull
exercises.precautions: Wide stance, toes turned out, one dumbbell held by one head between your legs;Squat, then as you stand pull the weight up to chest height, elbows wide;Keep knees tracking out over your toes;Lower the weight with the squat, under control
exercises.cues: Wide squat;Stand and pull to chest;Elbows wide and high

exercises.name: Alternating Lunge with Press
exercises.precautions: Dumbbells at shoulder height;Lunge forward or back and press overhead as you reach the bottom (or as you stand);Keep the torso tall - never press by arching your back;Alternate legs each rep
exercises.cues: Lunge tall;Press as you move;Alternate legs

exercises.name: Suitcase Squat
exercises.precautions: Hold one dumbbell at your side like a suitcase;Squat without leaning toward or away from the weight;The anti-lean brace is the whole point;Switch hands each round or halfway
exercises.cues: Weight at your side;Squat tall, no leaning;Brace against the load

exercises.name: Step Squat + Back
exercises.precautions: Light dumbbells at your sides;Step to the side into a squat, then step back to centre;Keep knees tracking over toes;Alternate the stepping side
exercises.cues: Step wide, squat;Step back to centre;Alternate sides

exercises.name: Lunge + High Knee Kick
exercises.precautions: Lunge back with one leg;As you return, drive that knee up high (kick-through in the source);Stay tall and balanced - light dumbbells only;Finish all reps on one side before switching, as the source numbers them
exercises.cues: Lunge back;Drive the knee up tall;All reps one side, then switch

exercises.name: Sumo Squat to Calf Raise
exercises.precautions: Wide sumo stance, toes turned out;Squat down, and as you stand rise onto your toes;Knees track out over the toes the whole time;Lower heels softly before the next squat
exercises.cues: Wide squat;Stand up onto toes;Heels lower softly

exercises.name: DB Reverse Lunge
exercises.precautions: Dumbbells hang at your sides;Step BACK into the lunge, torso tall;Front knee tracks over its toes;Push through the front heel to stand
exercises.cues: Step back, drop tall;Front knee tracks straight;Drive through the front heel

exercises.name: Side Lunge
exercises.precautions: Step wide to one side and sit hips back and down;The other leg stays straight, toes forward;Bent knee tracks over its toes;Push through the bent leg's heel to return
exercises.cues: Step wide, sit to one side;Straight leg stays straight;Push back through the heel

exercises.name: 180-Degree Jump Turns
exercises.precautions: Land softly on the balls of your feet, knees tracking over toes;Turn only as far as you can control in the air;Keep landings quiet - if they get loud, slow down;Stop if your knees or ankles feel unstable
exercises.cues: Squat a little, jump and turn;Land soft, facing the new way;Reset your feet, repeat

exercises.name: Air Kicks
exercises.precautions: Stay light on your feet - small kicks only;Keep your core braced and posture tall;Kick only as high as your hamstrings comfortably allow;Stop if you feel a pull behind the knee
exercises.cues: Alternate gentle front kicks;Stay tall and relaxed;Keep a steady rhythm

exercises.name: Barbell Squat
exercises.precautions: Bar rests on your upper back, not on your neck;Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out, whole foot grounded;Knees track over toes - never cave inward;Only squat as deep as you can with a flat back
exercises.cues: Brace your core, sit hips back and down;Drive up through the whole foot;Keep your chest tall throughout

exercises.name: Box Jumps
exercises.precautions: Use a low, rock-solid box or step that cannot tip;Land softly with both feet flat and knees soft;Always step down - never jump backwards off;Stop the set when your landings get heavy
exercises.cues: Swing your arms and jump up;Land quiet and stand tall on top;Step down, reset, repeat

exercises.name: Jump Step-Ups
exercises.precautions: Use a low step that cannot slide or tip;Land with your whole foot on the step;Explode up, but land controlled on every rep;Step down carefully between reps
exercises.cues: Drive off one leg onto the step;Land soft, stand tall;Alternate legs

exercises.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Reverse Lunge
exercises.precautions: Bell rests in the rack: wrist straight, elbow tucked to ribs;Step back into the lunge with a tall torso;Front knee tracks over toes;Push through the front heel to stand
exercises.cues: Rack the bell, stand tall;Step back, lower straight down;Drive up through the front leg

exercises.name: Manmaker
exercises.precautions: Dumbbells on the floor, wrists straight under shoulders;Row from a strong plank - no hip rocking;Jump your feet in and clean the bells to your shoulders as you stand;Use a weight you fully control through the press
exercises.cues: Plank, row each side;Jump in, stand and clean;Press tall, then reset

exercises.name: One-Legged Squat
exercises.precautions: Advanced - hold a support or sit back to a box;Knee tracks over toes on the standing leg;Lower only as deep as you can control;Free leg stays off the floor if you can - a light toe tap is fine
exercises.cues: Stand on one leg, arms forward;Sit back and down slowly;Drive up through the whole foot

exercises.name: Overhead Squat
exercises.precautions: Arms locked overhead, biceps by your ears;If your heels lift or arms drift forward, reduce the depth;Knees track over toes throughout;Move slowly - this is a mobility-strength drill
exercises.cues: Reach tall, brace your core;Squat keeping your arms vertical;Stand, staying tall

exercises.name: Resistance Band Squat
exercises.precautions: Stand on the band, feet shoulder-width, handles at your shoulders;Sit back and down, knees tracking over toes;Keep tension on the band throughout;Inspect the band before every set
exercises.cues: Brace with the band at your shoulders;Squat down with control;Drive up through both feet

exercises.name: Rolling Squat Tuck-Up Jump
exercises.precautions: Advanced plyometric - needs clear floor space;Roll back only onto your upper back, never your neck;Use the roll momentum to stand, then jump straight up;Land soft and reset fully between reps
exercises.cues: Squat down, roll back smoothly;Roll up into the squat;Explode into a tuck jump

exercises.name: Transverse Lunge and Chop
exercises.precautions: Step out to the side and slightly back, knee tracking over toes;Rotate through your trunk as your arms chop across;Keep the front heel grounded;Move under control - balance first
exercises.cues: Step wide and rotate;Chop your arms across your body;Push back to centre

stretches.name: Standing Quadriceps Stretch
stretches.precautions: Move gently until you feel a mild stretch - never force;Breathe slowly and relax into it - no bouncing;Keep posture tall and supported where you can
stretches.cues: Move gently to a mild stretch;Breathe slowly, never force it

stretches.name: Couch Stretch
stretches.precautions: Move gently until you feel a mild stretch - never force;Breathe slowly and relax into it - no bouncing;Keep posture tall and supported where you can
stretches.cues: Move gently to a mild stretch;Breathe slowly, never force it

stretches.name: Malasana (Deep Squat Hold)
stretches.precautions: Feet flat if you can - heels on a folded towel is fine;Elbows press gently into inner knees;Chest stays lifted, back long;Come out slowly if knees or ankles feel strained
stretches.cues: Sit deep between your heels;Elbows into knees, chest up;Breathe and settle
